description: Use when an agent needs to check an x402 endpoint's payment challenge before paying it. Returns a verdict, a 0 to 100 score and 32 checks, paywall bypass included. Never pays. An unreachable endpoint answers 503 and a refused URL 400, neither charged. Costs 0.05 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

method.description: HTTP method to check, default GET (a POST is sent with an empty body)

url.description: the x402 endpoint to check, URL-encoded: http or https, a public host, port 80 or 443

name: get_x402_lint

data.description: the get_x402_lint payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_x402_lint

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: x402 challenge lint
